checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Translucent washes, soft edges, paper texture and white vignette.
Stone cottage with chimneys, windows and door is clear.
Stream with reflections runs along the cottage's front.
Pale green rolling hills sit behind the cottage.

faults.what: Slightly digital-clean linework in the cottage; minor perspective oddity in the stone wall at left.

summary: A charming square watercolour of a stone cottage beside a stream with soft green hills behind it, meeting every requirement with no text.
